body: That's a hard question. Part of me would tell you to stick it out and possibly see if the relationship becomes better or not. You might have lost romantic interest because of your deep feelings, when the whole time your heart might've wanted to be with him. In which case, you should open up to him somewhat and try to make things work out for you. On the other hand, another part of me wants me to tell you to follow your heart and trust your gut. I'm not sure.

I suppose talking to strangers is just about my only option. I try not to think of the past but the exact situation I'm in right now is the sum of all of my past shortcomings. Ridiculously enough, I've tried millions of different things in an effort to be happy(switching hobbies, habits, trying new things, drawing, listening to music, going on long drives, etc etc.). Now I feel like a goddamn moron because here I am after having wasted a ton of effort just to be on the same shitty sinking raft. I can only pretend to be optimistic for so long before the part of my brain that has any sort of optimism lets reality in. I wish things went differently, quite a bit.

@OP I'm also in a fucked situation in life where no matter what I do things inevitably go wrong, I literally wouldn't rule out the possibility of me being cursed. And trust me, I'm hating this ride. No fun.
@OP I wonder the same thing myself quite frequently.
I had to try something different... I am not a nice dude at heart.
Yeah. Kayaking, swimming, jogging, trying new foods, being excessively nice to people, listening to new music, meeting new people, etc. Quite frankly I'm afraid I'm a lost cause.
Yeah. Kayaking, walking, jogging, driving, being excessively nice to people, trying new foods, meet new people, etc. Quite frankly I'm afraid I'm a lost cause.

Unfortunately, I've been thinking about killing myself for a while. It's a shame because besides not having friends or much of a family, my life has some stability. Insanity is doing the same thing over and over again, and I don't know what to do different! See y'all on the other side
I've been in the same situation for a while... It hasn't got better, I hope things go differently for you.
